rules.label: Journalism basis (§ 4, first sentence) without consent.

law_references.quote: Personal data may be processed and disclosed in the media for journalistic purposes without the consent of the data subject, in particular disclosed in the media, if there is public interest and this is in accordance with the principles of journalism ethics.
law_references.note: Cited as “§ 4, first sentence”. Three-condition journalism basis.

rules.label: Consent baseline under the Personal Data Protection Act.

law_references.quote: Personal data may be processed and disclosed in the media for journalistic purposes without the consent of the data subject ...
law_references.note: Cited as “§ 4 (implicit consent baseline)”. Consent is the general baseline; the journalism basis is its exception.

rules.label: Excessive harm defeats ethics compliance (§ 4, second sentence).

law_references.quote: Disclosure of personal data must not cause excessive damage to the rights of any data subjects.
law_references.note: Cited as “§ 4, second sentence”. Proportionality override of the ethics condition.
